CFTC Regulation Part 45: Swap Data Recordkeeping and Reporting Requirements

Regulator: Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC)
Jurisdiction: United States
Publication Date: 2012-01-13
Effective Date: 2012-03-13
Source URL: https://www.cftc.gov/LawRegulation/FederalRegister/2012/01/13/77-FR-2136
License: Public Domain - Works of the U.S. Government not subject to copyright

Section 1: Applicability
This rule applies to all swap dealers and major swap participants operating in US markets.

Section 2: Daily Reporting
Reporting entities must submit daily transaction reports by 10:00 AM Eastern Time. Reports must include the unique swap identifier (USI) and counterparty details.

Section 3: Recordkeeping
All reports and supporting documentation must be stored in an immutable format for seven years.
